$comment: Vercel WAF custom rules as code (wave 6b). Edge layer in front of the app-level limits (Upstash): it sheds floods before a function is invoked, it does not replace them. Applied with scripts/vercel-firewall.ts (prints staged CLI commands; the owner reviews `vercel firewall diff` and publishes). Rule names are the identity: every rule here starts with `lp-`.

rules.name: lp-leads-methods
rules.description: POST /v1/leads only accepts POST and the CORS preflight; anything else is denied at the edge.

rules.name: lp-leads-ip-rate
rules.description: Coarse per-IP ceiling on lead submissions (app limit is 5 per 10 min per IP; this only stops floods).

rules.name: lp-internal-methods
rules.description: QStash callbacks under /internal/ are POST only.

rules.name: lp-crm-ip-rate
rules.description: Per-IP ceiling on the staff API; per-user quotas (120 read / 30 write per minute) stay in the app.
